note: The control ledger. It is edited by hand, and control C23 in agent-workspace-flows.spec.ts checks that hand against the deployed page: it enumerates every focusable control the two screens actually render and requires the set to equal the `dom` values below. A control that ships without an entry here fails that test rather than quietly shrinking the denominator. Entries with an empty `dom` are behaviours rather than elements (a redirect, an API status, an error state), so nothing in the DOM can enumerate them. The coverage file is generated from a live run and is not committed; see the build script. Never renumber an id once a run has used it.

not_present.why: The task console has no live transcript surface yet (task-console.tsx: "There is no live transcript yet"), so there is no control to enumerate.
not_present.guard: C23 asserts the tasks screen renders no role=log element, so this claim fails the run the day a transcript ships.

controls.description: Sign-in: required attributes are advisory only, because the form is noValidate, so an empty submit reaches the server and surfaces the same error as a wrong password
Start task button with empty instructions shows inline validation and fires no request
Task create round-trips through POST /v1/agent/tasks and the new row appears in the list
EngineNotice reflects the deployment's current runtime state, so it is absent while a real agent runtime is configured
Cancel button stops a task that is still running, and a second cancel on the now-terminal task is refused server side with 409
Empty state ("Nothing submitted yet") when the list holds no tasks
Task list load failure renders the retry/reload banner
Task create failure renders its own error, keeps the draft text
Expired session reported instead of a silent failure on submit
Every focusable control rendered on the sign-in and tasks screens is claimed by this ledger, and no live transcript pane exists yet
